read_html_parse_tables: read HTML tables from a URL, file path, or string into a list of DataFrames
read_html_with_flavor: read HTML tables using a specific parser flavor such as lxml or html5lib
read_html_extract_links: read HTML tables and extract href links from anchor tags in specified sections
read_html_filter_by_attrs: read HTML tables filtered by matching attributes like id or class
read_html_skiprows_parse_dates: read HTML tables skipping specified rows and parsing date columns
